chunks: A man's gift to his wife increases her chastity.

key_terms.عِفَّتِهَا: her chastity, modesty, and moral restraint
key_terms.لِزَوْجَتِهِ: to his wife, within the marital relationship
key_terms.هِبَةُ الرَّجُلِ: the husband’s act of giving a gift

ai.seo_question: How does giving gifts to one's wife affect the marital relationship in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that generosity from a husband toward his wife strengthens moral restraint and fidelity within the marriage. It presents kind giving within the household as a means of nurturing affection, dignity, and marital harmony.
